title: Automatic async error handling wrapper for route handlers
description: Provides a built‑in wrapper that catches rejected promises from async route handlers and forwards them to the framework’s error middleware. This eliminates repetitive try/catch boilerplate and prevents unhandled promise rejections in production.
testCases: Async route that throws an error results in the error middleware being invoked with the correct error object
Async route that resolves successfully returns the expected response without invoking the error middleware
acceptance: All existing and new tests pass; no unhandled promise rejections appear in logs when async routes throw; documentation includes usage example and changelog entry.
reason: Improves developer ergonomics and production stability by ensuring all async route errors are consistently handled, reducing boiler‑plate and the risk of silent failures.
